name: vibeheal
description: VibeHeal: a safety net for broken JavaScript/TypeScript projects, with a backend-managed integration marketplace.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.waitlist.json --noEmit && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:waitlist && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.site:dev: npm run build:waitlist && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.waitlist dist/waitlist/cli.js serve
scripts.waitlist:report: npm run build:waitlist && node dist/waitlist/cli.js report
scripts.waitlist:export: npm run build:waitlist && node dist/waitlist/cli.js export
scripts.build:desktop: tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.preload.json && vite build --config desktop/vite.config.ts
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:server && npm run start:server
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start:desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:site && npm test && npm run build
scripts.waitlist:hash-password: npm run build:waitlist && node dist/waitlist/cli.js hash-password
